containers.name: experiment
command:
mkdir -p /results/swm-latent-api-smoke-v1-work
tar xzf /source/app.tar.gz -C /results/swm-latent-api-smoke-v1-work
cd /results/swm-latent-api-smoke-v1-work
export PYTHONPATH=/results/swm-latent-api-smoke-v1-work:/results/swm-latent-api-smoke-v1-work/deps:/results/work/upstream
export DREAMER_SOURCE=/results/work/upstream
/results/venv/bin/python - <<'PYCODE'
import json,time,uuid
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from microservice.live import wait_ready,configure,batch,reset_measurement_window,frame,reset
from microservice.environment import Incident
from microservice.evaluate import agent
out=Path('/results/micro-latent-api-v1/promotion-smoke.json')
if out.exists():raise RuntimeError('Preserve existing smoke evidence')
expected=json.loads(Path('/results/micro-latent-api-v1/serving/readout-23.json').read_text())['readout_sha256']
wait_ready();start=time.monotonic()
try:
 n=configure(0,np.random.default_rng(6902),True)
 for _ in range(2):
  if batch(n)!=n:raise RuntimeError('Warmup failed')
 reset_measurement_window();frames=[frame(n)];state=Incident(frames,0,compositional=True);v=state.observe().tolist();trace=[];incident=str(uuid.uuid4())
 for t in range(4):
  r=agent(23,v,t==0,0. if t==0 else -.2,incident);trace.append(dict(observation=v,response=r))
  if t<3:
   if r['action']!=t+1:raise RuntimeError('Inspection mismatch')
   frames.append(frame(n));v=state.step(r['action'])[0].tolist()
 valid=all(f['successes']==n and all(m['count']==(j+1)*n for m in f['metrics'].values()) for j,f in enumerate(frames))
 result=dict(healthy=r['action']==4,controller=r['controller'],readout_sha256=r.get('readout_sha256'),seconds=time.monotonic()-start,valid_windows=valid,trace=trace,frames=frames)
 out.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
 assert result['healthy'] and valid and result['seconds']<=35 and result['controller']=='inspect-latent' and result['readout_sha256']==expected
 print('HEALTHY_API_SMOKE_PASSED',flush=True)
finally:reset()
PYCODE
